apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- pcsx2: add the DEV9 arcade-board files to the MSVC project
- Arcade: the System 256 BIOS for every game, the 246 one for Battle Gear 3
- Arcade controls: a layout for all arcade games
- Arcade: Arcade controls, the player's own layout per game
- GS/Vulkan: keep the shared DATE copy's pass untiled with one loop declaration
- GS/Vulkan: drop the shared DATE stencil copy on a clear inside the pass
- GS/Vulkan: share one DATE stencil copy across a run of alpha-bit shadow draws
- GS: name GSAlphaBitLogicOp.h in the MSVC project
- GS/Vulkan: set and clear alpha bit 7 with a logic op where a read waits per draw
- microVU: the full-width sign clamp reads the resident clamp bounds
- GS/HW: draw over-one (Cd - Cs) * As in two hardware passes on the copy road
- Arcade: keep what games write to a CHD hard drive
- Arcade: racing games' test menus can be entered
- Arcade: say which games only reach their attract demo
- Arcade: every arcade BIOS in use, each game on its own board's
- Android: let libchdr open arcade hard drive CHDs
- Android: write the data folder off the main thread, and only when needed
- Arcade: find games where they are, instead of importing them
- Arcade: open big hard drive CHDs, and read them like raw images
- github: fixup templates to point to the right places for ARMSX2
- iOS: build for the A10, the oldest chip that can install the app

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261004...8f6da1639fb10dcd4a43d84113d770b6edf2c0c1
